lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. Hai tempo? Just five more minutes. What has no feet but—oh, a leaf! Aspetta, dove vai?
lines.translation: Hi! I'm Flick. Do you have time? Just five more minutes. What has no feet but—oh, a leaf! Wait, where are you going?
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly merely relocates the problem. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma che cosa? Una foglia? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Vuoi che io resti qui? What runs but never—oh, another leaf!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But at what? A leaf? You told me to look, not stop moving. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Do you want me to stay here? What runs but never—oh, another leaf!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already elsewhere, having mistaken a drifting leaf for a plan.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Dove devo andare? Qual è la strada che—oh, una farfalla! Your attention span: surprisingly threatening. Dammi una direzione. We can actually go later. Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Where should I go? Which is the road that—oh, a butterfly! Your attention span: surprisingly threatening. Give me a direction. We can actually go later. Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker lands where your patience used to be.

lines.native: Left? In inglese! Capisco, ma serve una direzione in italiano. Dove devo andare? What has three roads and—oh, dust. Just five more minutes?
lines.translation: Left? In English! I understand, but a direction in Italian is needed. Where should I go? What has three roads and—oh, dust. Just five more minutes?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains firmly in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: Sempre diritto, sì! La direzione è giusta. Ma perché partire? Possiamo andare domani. Direction: ten out of ten. What is always coming but—oh, a moth! Aspetta ancora un minuto. Just one more.
lines.translation: Straight ahead, yes! The direction is right. But why leave? We can go tomorrow. Direction: ten out of ten. What is always coming but—oh, a moth! Wait another minute. Just one more.
lines.narrative: Flick heads straight ahead, then vanishes into the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces a proposed postponement.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Non partiamo oggi. Hai scelto domani, proprio come voglio io! Procrastination: ten out of ten. Ma tu vuoi partire? What never arrives but—oh, una mosca! Ancora cinque minuti?
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! We aren't leaving today. You chose tomorrow, just as I want! Procrastination: ten out of ten. But do you want to leave? What never arrives but—oh, a fly! Five more minutes?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already in a different corner of your vision, celebrating a departure postponed indefinitely.

lines.native: Adesso? Hai ragione! Non domani. Va bene, andiamo! Ma prima—no? Your attention span: ten out of ten. Che cosa corre senza—oh, aspetta! Vengo anch’io!
lines.translation: Now? You're right! Not tomorrow. All right, let's go! But first—no? Your attention span: ten out of ten. What runs without—oh, wait! I'm coming too!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has accepted the urgency, though not with any professional enthusiasm.
